properties.displayName: Enforce custom rules on Application Gateway WAF policies
properties.description: Enforces supplied Application Gateway custom rules with a PolicyEnforced name suffix and the selected action. Reconciles managed rule settings, preserves unrelated rules, and allocates conflicting priorities from 50 through 100.

metadata.description: An array of 1 through 10 Application Gateway custom rule objects, with 1 through 10 conditions per rule and 1 through 10 match variables per condition. Names receive PolicyEnforced unless already suffixed. All managed settings are enforced. Unrelated rules are preserved. Requested priorities must be 1 through 100; conflicts use the lowest unused value from 50 through 100.
ARM action applied to every supplied rule. FromRule uses each object's action instead. Only matching PolicyEnforced rules are managed.
Deploy or correct managed custom rules, audit any managed rule configuration drift, or disable evaluation.
